notes.zh-CN: 修复手机版登录后提示「网络连接失败」、电脑会话无法加载的问题，恢复被安全策略拦截的安全 WebSocket 实时同步。已验证 Android 0.56.1 覆盖升级至 0.56.2。macOS 为 universal 包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名，沿用上版签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: Fixed mobile sessions failing with a network error after sign-in by restoring secure WebSocket synchronization blocked by the page security policy. Verified an in-place Android upgrade from 0.56.1 to 0.56.2. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK retains the previous debug signing identity; the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
